title: Tetradecanuclear polycarbonatolanthanoid clusters: Diverse coordination modes of carbonate providing access to novel core geometries

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, Gd(NO3)3·6H2O (130 mg, 288 μmol) was dissolved in methanol (2 ml) and added to 1,10-phenanthroline monohydrate (114 mg, 575 μmol) in methanol (2 ml), giving a white precipitate. (Et4N)(ccnm) (80 mg, 330 μmol) in methanol (1 ml) and Na2CO3 (31 mg, 293 μmol) in water (1 ml) were then added, producing additional precipitate. Over four months the precipitate began to dissolve and small yellow needle crystals of 1·26H2O formed. Crystals were manually separated from remaining precipitate, washed with methanol and air-dried for three days. Isolated product was insoluble in available solvents. Yield 15 mg, 11%.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic direct reaction in methanol–water; slow crystallization from dissolving precipitate
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: yellow needle crystals formed over four months; manually separated from remaining precipitate, washed with methanol, air-dried for three days

properties.summary: DC susceptibility of the Gd14 cluster is Curie-like from 300 to ~20 K, with χMT slightly below the uncoupled 14×Gd(III) value; low-T field dependence is attributed to Zeeman/ZFS effects and possibly extremely weak antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetization nearly saturates at 2 K/5 T (98 Nβ). No hysteresis. Ferromagnetic S=49 ground-state coupling is ruled out.

measurements.conditions: S=7/2, g=2.0, C=7.875 cm3 mol−1 K per Gd

measurements.name: magnetization M
measurements.conditions: 2 K, 50000 Oe; near saturation for fourteen S=7/2 centres

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, DyCl3·6H2O (108 mg, 287 μmol) was dissolved in methanol (2 ml) and added to Na2CO3 (31 mg, 293 μmol) in water (1 ml), giving a white precipitate. 1,10-Phenanthroline monohydrate (114 mg, 575 μmol) in methanol (2 ml) and (Et4N)(ccnm) (80 mg, 330 μmol) in methanol (1 ml) were added. Over four months the precipitate began to dissolve and small yellow needle crystals of 2·26H2O formed. Crystals were manually separated from remaining precipitate, washed with methanol and air-dried for three days. Isolated product was insoluble in available solvents. Yield 21 mg, 15%. Differs from 1 by an additional ccnm ligand in place of chelating nitrate.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic analogous reaction in methanol–water; slow crystallization from dissolving precipitate
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: yellow needle crystals formed over four months; manually separated from remaining precipitate, washed with methanol, air-dried for three days

properties.summary: χMT of Dy14 decreases gradually from 300 to ~50 K then sharply at low T in 10000 Oe, below the uncoupled 14×Dy(III) value, consistent with ligand-field/anisotropy effects and possibly very weak antiferromagnetic coupling. M vs H does not saturate (73 Nβ at 2 K/5 T). No hysteresis. AC χM'' is frequency-dependent below ~6 K without maxima, indicating possible slow magnetization reversal/SMM-like behaviour.
